                                   技有限公司), a limited liability company established in the PRC on
                                   November 18, 1999 and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Lepu Medical,

「天地和協」                         指   北京天地和協科技有限公司，一家於1999 年11 月18 日在中國成立的
                                   有限公司，為本公司控股股東之一樂普醫療的全資附屬公司

 “TAVR”                            transcatheter aortic valve replacement, a catheter-based technique
                                   to implant a new aortic valve in a minimally invasive procedure
                                   that does not involve open-chest surgery to correct severe aortic
                                   stenosis
「經導管主動脈瓣置換術」                   指   經導管主動脈瓣置換術，一種基於導管的技術，通過不涉及開胸手術
                                   的微創手術植入新的主動脈瓣，以矯正嚴重的主動脈瓣狹窄

 “TMVCRS”                          transapical mitral valve repair system (chordal), a catheter-based
                                   system with two configurations, one enabling artificial mitral chordae
                                   implantation and the other enabling edge-to-edge chordae repair
「TMVCRS」                       指   經心尖二尖瓣修復系統（腱索），一種基於導管且具備兩種裝置的系
                                   統，一種實現人工二尖瓣腱索植入，另一種實現緣對緣腱索修復

 “TMVR”                            transcatheter mitral valve repair, which provides a newer, minimally
                                   invasive option for treating the most common form of mitral valve
                                   leakage for people who cannot undergo open-heart surgery. It
                                   is implanted via a tri-axial transcatheter technique and involves
                                   suturing together the anterior and posterior mitral valve leaflets
「TMVR」                         指   經導管二尖瓣修復術，為無法接受心臟直視手術的人治療最常見的二
                                   尖瓣滲漏提供了一種更新、微創選擇。通過三軸經導管技術進行植
                                   入，包括縫合二尖瓣前後瓣葉

    「室間隔缺損」                                  指     室間隔缺損，心臟左右心室的隔膜的缺損或孔洞，嚴重者可能導致血

Foreign Exchange Risk Management                                    外匯風險管理

Our functional currency is RMB. Foreign exchange risk arises        我們的功能貨幣為人民幣。當未來的商業
when future commercial transactions or recognized assets            交易或已確認的資產及負債以並非我們功
and liabilities are denominated in a currency that is not our       能貨幣的貨幣計值時，即會產生外匯風
functional currency. We expose ourselves to foreign exchange        險。由於我們的若干應付賬款、應收賬款
risk because certain of our accounts payable, accounts              以及貨幣資金以外幣計值，因而使我們面
receivable and cash at bank and on hand are denominated in          臨外匯風險。我們將通過不斷審視經濟形
foreign currencies. We will mitigate such a risk by constantly      勢和外匯風險，並在必要時採取對沖措施
reviewing the economic situation and foreign exchange risk, and     緩解風險。
applying hedging measures when necessary.

                               Case: Clinical study of MemoSorb® degradable ASD occluder brings
                                                new treatment options for patients
                               案例：MemoSorb® 生物可降解ASD封堵器臨床研究為患者帶來全新治療選擇

                     In June 2024, at the 18th Oriental Cardiology Conference and the World Congress
                     of Cardiology, the one-year follow-up results of the clinical study of the MemoSorb ®
                     biodegradable ASD occluder developed by the Company were officially announced. The
                     study results strongly demonstrated the positive efficacy and safety of the MemoSorb ®
                     degradable ASD occluder. As an original Chinese innovative device in the field of structural
                     heart disease, it effectively addresses the current clinical challenges of permanent
                     implantation, which hinders the establishment of transseptal left heart interventional access
                     and is unsuitable for patients with metal allergies. This advancement offers new treatment
                     options for a broader range of patients with atrial septal defects.
                     2024 年6 月，在第十八屆東方心臟病學會議和世界心臟病學大會中，心泰醫療研發的
                     MemoSorb ® 生物可降解ASD封堵器臨床研究的一年隨訪結果正式公佈。該研究結果有力驗證了
                     MemoSorb ® 可降解ASD封堵器積極的有效性和安全性，充分顯示出其作為結構心領域中國原創
                     創新器械的強大，解決了當前臨床封堵器植入後終身留存患者體內、阻礙經房間隔穿刺左心介
                     入通路建立及金屬過敏患者不適用的難題，為更多房間隔缺損患者帶來了全新的治療選擇。

the risks associated with achieving our business objectives.        重大錯誤陳述或損失提供合理但非絕對的
These systems provide a reasonable but not absolute assurance       保證。

X.   DISCLOSURE OF FAIR VALUE                                         十、 公允價值的披露

     Inputs used in the fair value measurement are divided into            公允價值計量所使用的輸入值劃分
     three levels:                                                         為三個層次：

     Level 1 inputs refer to quoted prices (unadjusted) in active          第一層次輸入值是在計量日能夠取
     markets for identical assets or liabilities available on the          得的相同資產或負債在活躍市場上
     measurement date.                                                     未經調整的報價。

     Level 2 inputs refer to inputs that are directly or indirectly        第二層次輸入值是除第一層次輸入
     observable for the asset or liability other than Level 1              值外相關資產或負債直接或間接可
     inputs.                                                               觀察的輸入值。

     Level 3 inputs refer to unobservable inputs of the relevant           第三層次輸入值是相關資產或負債
     assets or liabilities.                                                的不可觀察輸入值。

     The level of the measurement result of fair value shall               公允價值計量結果所屬的層次，由
     subject to the lowest level which the input that is of                對公允價值計量整體而言具有重要
     great significance to the entire measurement of fair value            意義的輸入值所屬的最低層次決定。
     belongs to.

     (1)   Fair value of assets and liabilities measured at               （一）以公允價值計量的資產和負債
           fair value at the end of period                                   的期末公允價值

           As of December 31, 2024, there were no financial                     於2024 年12 月31 日，概無以
           assets or liabilities measured at fair value.                        公允價值計量的金融資產或負
                                                                                債。
